voice: Preserve Steve's direct dockworker recollections while removing the 1950s steamship mistakenly named in the 1926 story.

entries.text: I don't know anyone that important, Miss Bow. Wait--I saw him on the docks after his ship came in from England. He had the biggest, heaviest trunk I've ever seen, and it smelled strange.
The Dagger is supposed to be beautiful beyond belief. It is too bad we cannot see it. I helped unload the crate from the steamship, but Dr. Carter would not let anyone open it.
